description_sq:
Apartament ne shitje, 1+1 totalisht i mobiluar tek Hipoteka 
- Pjese e nje objekti te ri, ne trajten e nje kompleksi rezidencial, shume cilesore, i mireadministruar, kamera 24h, fare prane Unazes se Vogel dhe fillimit te Bulevardit, me cdo facilitet per nje jetese komode.
- Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 81m2 te organizuar ne sallonin e ndenjes bashke me kuzhinen/ambientin e ngrenies , dhoma e gjumit , nje tualet dhe veranda qe pershkon te gjithe ambientet me sip. 23m2 .
- Nje mundesi ideale, pasi ky apartament ofron te gjitha kushtet e pershtatshme si per banim ashtu edhe investim, ne nje zone me zhvillim te vrullshem, larmi sherbimesh dhe nje kerkese gjithmon ne rritje si per blerje ashtu edhe per qira.
- Apartamenti ofrohet totalisht i mobiluar si dhe disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
- Bashke me apartamentin ofrohet dhe nje post parkimi ne katin -1 te objektit me cmim ekstra 30`000 Euro.
- Per me shume informacion kontaktoni!
description_en: Apartment for sale, 1+1 fully furnished at Hipoteka - Part of a new building, in the form of a residential complex, very high quality, well managed, 24h camera, very close to the Vogel Ring and the beginning of the Boulevard, with every facility for a comfortable life. - The apartment has a total area of ​​81m2, organized in the living room together with the kitchen/dining room, bedroom, a toilet and a veranda that goes through all the rooms. 23m2. - An ideal opportunity, as this apartment offers all suitable conditions for both residence and investment, in an area with rapid development, variety of services and an ever-increasing demand for both purchase and rent. - The apartment is offered fully furnished and has regular mortgage documentation. - Along with the apartment, a parking space is offered on the -1st floor of the building with an extra price of 30,000 Euros. - For more information, contact us!
